record.question: All of the following statements are correct about potassium balance except:
options: Three quarters of total body potassium is found in skeletal muscles
Acidosis leads to movement of potassium from extracellular to intracellular fluid compartment

record.question: Measurement of what parameter is useful in determining the metabolic or respiratory acidosis or alkalosis?

Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK541123/; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK507821/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. record.question: What is the recommended IV fluid for a patient with severe dehydration?
record.explanation: Answer A: Normal saline (0.9% NaCl).
